title: Refresh the World - 0.1
description: Refresh the World - 0.1 is a some random modpack that make your minecraft world better
body:
**🌍 About the Modpack**


**Refresh the World - 0.1** offers a fresh Minecraft experience that doesn't stray from the vanilla experience. The focus is on performance, graphics, and quality-of-life, introducing content to the game that doesn't make the game overly complex. If you're builders, adventurers, or even just casual players, this modpack enhances all aspects of the game without making the game less optimized.


**⚠️ Performance Warning**


This modpack includes **high-resolution resource packs, and shader support.** It is **not recommended for low-end PCs**. A mid-to-high-end PC is **required** for smooth gameplay. If you experience lag, consider lowering shader settings or removing certain resource packs.
